name: Clockwork v0.5.6 [Forge 1.20.1] - MELTING POINT
changelog:
## 0.5.6
**big changes**

## Changes
- Updated tr_tr.json for newest version of mod by @AdamProGamingTR in https://github.com/ValkyrienSkies/Clockwork/pull/302
- Update zh_cn.json by @LogicWheat in https://github.com/ValkyrienSkies/Clockwork/pull/311
- Set max bearing angle to 90
- Merged @GigaBrawler 's joint stability PR. Joint blocks (Phys bearing, Hoses, Extendon, etc.) should be more stable
- Gas engine nerf
- Smart flap bearing slot colors match up now

## Fixes
- Fix delivery cannon targeting bugs
- Fix dual links not rendering with flywheel visuals by @zaafonin in https://github.com/ValkyrienSkies/Clockwork/pull/322
- Fix delivery cannon not dropping its internal itemstack on break by @zaafonin in https://github.com/ValkyrienSkies/Clockwork/pull/323
- Fix gas tanks not saving
- Make balloon casings drop items
- Fix clockwork blocks crashing schematics
- Fix kelvin ponder crashing on servers
- Fix getNode() log spam
- Fix methane recipe
- Fix Gas Backtank saving issues
